rules: Generate vPlan from current spec before testcase creation.
Every testcase must trace to one or more vPlan requirement IDs.
Testcase existence alone gives no final coverage credit.
UNSUPPORTED_BY_DUT may be WAIVED only with explicit current design-spec evidence and approval.
100% means every requirement is VERIFIED, approved WAIVED, or validated NOT_APPLICABLE.
Verification architecture/mechanism planning must occur before testcase generation.
Every testcase must trace to at least one planned verification mechanism unless the requirement is legitimately covered by another approved verification method.
Coverage hit without an effective checker/scoreboard/assertion/reference evidence is not sufficient proof of verification.
